title: Build a feature-to-code-and-test query
summary: Provide one query that traces a feature to implementation anchors, test definitions and available exact-commit runner evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Use First Spark and OBJ/MTL as independent examples.
List definitions separately from run results and show the source SHA for each.
For each example, verify a relationship that changes an implementation or test decision.

evidence.claim: The OBJ/MTL roundtrip links three implementation anchors and references both a smoke test and CI workflow.
